sentences.en: Investigators are running a probe into what caused the crash.
sentences.zh: 调查人员正在调查事故的原因。

sentences.en: The investigators tried to pin the blame on the pilot.
sentences.zh: 调查人员试图把责任推到飞行员身上。

sentences.en: Investigators exhumed the bodies of Fadil's wife, brother and father-in-law.
sentences.zh: 调查人员挖出了法蒂的妻子、兄弟和岳父的遗体。

senses.zh: 调查者;审查者 形容词: investigatorial
